title: __noZu
body:
__noZu Optimized Modpack

This modpack is designed to provide a smoother, more stable Minecraft experience while staying close to vanilla gameplay. The main focus is performance optimization along with useful quality-of-life support mods.

✨ Features
⚡ Performance optimization for better FPS
🧭 Minimap for easier navigation
🎤 Open mic / voice chat support
🎮 Vanilla-friendly gameplay
🔧 Additional support mods for convenience
📦 Pre-configured and ready to play
🎯 Purpose
This modpack is made for players who want to:

Improve FPS without changing core gameplay
Use voice chat in multiplayer
Navigate easily with a minimap
Enjoy a smoother and lighter experience
📌 Notes
No heavy gameplay-changing content
Focused on stability and performance
Suitable for singleplayer and multiplayer
This modpack will continue to be updated to maintain compatibility and performance.
